rows.en: Berkt's Movements
The New Federation Government

<library(1)><operator(30060,1)><speed(2)><color(5)>Berkt<ce()><thumbnail(189)> commands a <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> special task force, and is handling the investigation and capture of the <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()>.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>If the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> is behind his actions this time, it would be a grave matter, but I don't think that's it.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>That's because the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()>'s goal is to govern the Earth Sphere.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>In other words, it is highly likely that this matter is his own doing, acting on his own initiative.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>We don't know what his purpose is for now... but we need to pin down his whereabouts right away.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)><color(5)>Berkt<ce()> is an officer given a fair amount of discretion even within the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()>.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>It is probably his doing that information on the <color(4)>Nadesico<ce()> reached the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> at such an early stage too.
<thumbdown()><operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>Able to move for his own purposes while keeping the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> at his back... It's clear he's a formidable opponent.
<library(2)><topic()><operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>Let me explain about the organization known as the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()>.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>After the 7th Space War, the framework of nations vanished from a devastated Earth, and a long period of anarchy followed.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>The Federation Reconstruction Committee, formed by old Federation officials, created the United Federation of Predgio Towers.
rows.notes: 'Federation Reconstruction Committee' and 'United Federation of Predgio Towers' per encyclopedia_021_a locked spellings; this row has no book tags in the source.

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>This was an organization for managing the 157 towers built on the surface, and its heads were the ones known as the three Sages.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>The three Sages prioritized and pursued policies for restoring the Earth.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>But <book(40)>Fixx Bloodman<endbook()><thumbnail(179)>, a Committee leader, pushed to rule the colonies and unify the Earth Sphere.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>He then drove out the three Sages and established a new government. That is the current <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> government.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>From then to now, the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> has pursued a military buildup to keep the upper hand in its war with the colonies.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)><book(40)>Bloodman<endbook()> has four capable confidants, each given a high position.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>First, Colonel <color(5)>Dewey Novak<ce()><thumbnail(194)>, who belongs to the intelligence department.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>He is <color(4)>Holland<ce()>'s older brother, and carries on the plan Dr. <book(68)>Adroc Thurston<endbook()> once proposed: the <color(6)>Ageha Plan<ce()>.
rows.notes: 'Ageha Plan' per scene 4003260's locked rendering of book(78); here it appears as a plain color(6) span, not book(78), but the same English name is reused. Orchestrator: shortened to fit three lines.

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>He has been entrusted by <book(40)>Bloodman<endbook()> with countermeasures against the <book(72)>Coralians<endbook()>.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>Next are <book(40)>Bloodman<endbook()>'s confidants, so to speak - the brothers <color(5)>Shagia Frost<ce()> and <color(5)>Olba Frost<ce()><thumbnail(278)>.
rows.notes: 'Olba Frost', not 'Orba' - per character_names_021.json locked spelling (en_full 'Olba Frost'; 'Orba Frost' listed only as a variant).

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>They command a mobile suit battalion, entrusted with putting down rebels and handling colony forces.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>They were once known as skilled freelance <book(39)>Vultures<endbook()>, but their skill was recognized and won them their current post.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>And the fourth is... <color(5)>Berkt<ce()><thumbnail(191)>, the one we're pursuing.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>He has been given the mission of securing the <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()>, but he is an officer shrouded in a great deal of mystery.
<thumbdown()><operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>There will likely be more chances to fight the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> from here on. I want you to remember that.

uncertainties.issue: Locked spelling is 'Olba Frost' (character_names_021.json en_full); 'Orba Frost' is listed there only as a variant/alternate romanization, flagging in case another scene used the variant.

Slot 37 'Adroc Thurston' and 'Ageha Plan' confirmed locked spellings (encyclopedia_021_b.json/022.json); the source uses a plain color(6) span here rather than book(78), correctly reproduced without inventing a book tag not present in the source.
Slot 36 'Dewey Novak' and slot 39 'Shagia Frost' confirmed locked spellings against character_names_021.json/mission_terms_019.json.

Slots 19-44 checked line-by-line against source (Berkt's task-force command, New Federation's true goal, his own-initiative actions, his discretion within New Federation, New Federation government's founding history, the four confidants) - all match; no reversed meaning, wrong addressee, or invented subject found.
